title: The plants and planters
summary: Supermarket Simulator ships plants and planters as pieces of their own: planters with their own sheets in numbered kinds, flowers named apart from the pots, and trees for the ground and the shop.
body: Supermarket Simulator ships plants as pieces of their own rather than as part of a wall or a display. A planter is named as an object with its own sheets, so what holds the plant is as much a placed thing as the plant itself.
The planters are numbered. Several kinds are named, each with levels of detail of its own, which is why a shop can be greened without the same pot appearing twice.

The plants are named apart from the pots. A set of flowers is named with a colour sheet and a normal map of its own, and the art that goes with it is a sheet of leaves, ferns and two flowering shrubs rather than a single picture of one plant.

There is greenery for outside as well. Trees are named for the ground, numbered into a set, and a pair of shop trees is named beside them, so the same idea covers what stands outside and what stands on the shop floor.

That is why the plants are worth treating as stock of a kind. They are pieces the game ships and the shop can buy and place, which is what makes them a way to dress a corner rather than an accident of the map.

They also give the shop somewhere to put what a player has earned. A plant is not a shelf, so it changes the look of a room without changing what the room can sell, which is exactly what furniture is for.
The entry is filed with the layout rather than with the stock because that is what it does: it dresses a room, and the room still has to make money on its own.
What this entry does not tell you: what any plant costs, whether customers notice one, or which plants unlock at which shop level. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: A planter is a piece of its own, with a colour sheet, an ambient-occlusion sheet, a metallic-smoothness sheet and a normal map.
facts.evidence: asset names: Flowerpot, Flowerpot_A, Flowerpot_AO, Flowerpot_MS, Flowerpot_N

facts.claim: Planters are numbered into kinds with several levels of detail each.
facts.evidence: asset names: Flowerpot_01_LOD0, Flowerpot_02_LOD0, Flowerpot_04_LOD1, Flowerpot_05_LOD2.001, Flowerpot_09_LOD0

facts.claim: The plants are named apart from the pots, with their own colour sheet and normal map.
Trees are named for the ground as well as for the shop: ground trees numbered into a set and a pair of shop trees.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ground _Tree_01, Ground _Tree_03_LOD1, SM_Tree_B, SM_Tree_C

alt.en: The plant sheet the game ships: leaves, ferns and two flowering shrubs laid out together.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的植物贴图集：叶片、蕨类与两丛开花灌木。

sources: A local copy of the game, read only. The grounding for each fact is listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
